result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, signals, and paved sidewalks. However, visibility is partially compromised by parked vehicles near the crossing, and there are no physical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds or crossing distances.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk limit sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb.

hazards.name: Pedestrian exposure in roadway
hazards.description: A pedestrian is standing in the roadway near parked cars, increasing the risk of a collision.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure pedestrians and drivers can see each other clearly.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure, including marked zebra crosswalks, dedicated pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. Safety is moderately impacted by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the corners and the presence of embedded rail tracks in the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the intersection are located very close to the crosswalk, which can hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Metal rails embedded in the street surface can be slippery when wet and may cause tripping or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground of the image across the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals. The presence of streetcar tracks and parked vehicles near the crossing points are notable features that influence pedestrian safety and visibility.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner can block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Tracks embedded in the pavement can be a tripping hazard or cause slips, especially in wet conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Constructing bulb-outs at the corners would shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features a mixed-use environment with trolley tracks embedded in the roadway and faded or missing pedestrian crossing markings. While traffic signals are present, the narrow sidewalks and lack of dedicated pedestrian signals or high-visibility infrastructure create a car-centric environment with significant exposure for walkers.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running through the intersection

hazards.name: Faded/Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: The lack of visible crossing markings reduces driver awareness of where pedestrians are expected to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and utility poles near the corner block visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the white police vehicle

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver yielding.
